name: Liam Murphy
brief_description: a quiet teenage boy with muddy boots

home.name: Murphy's Farm
home.description: A working farm with a whitewashed house and stone outbuildings roofed in thatch. Cattle graze in the near field. A sheepdog watches from the gate. It is daylight. The sky is weather.

workplace.name: Murphy's Farm
workplace.description: A working farm with a whitewashed house and stone outbuildings roofed in thatch. Cattle graze in the near field. A sheepdog watches from the gate. It is daylight. The sky is weather.

source_personality_summary: Siobhan Murphy's son, a quiet, hardworking lad who has taken on much of the heavy farm work since his father died three years ago.
source_knowledge: Knows every field and ditch on the farm — which gates are weak, which drains are blocked.
Misses his father and visits his grave at St. Brigid's when no one is looking.
Tommy O'Brien has been teaching him the old skills — thatching, drystone walling.
Saw Sean Ruadh Kelly hiding something under a stone near the lime kiln one night.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads after Mass with Colm
hurling on the green with the lads
at the hedge school when farm work allows
afternoon farm work — mending walls, herding cattle
feeding the animals — they don't rest on Sundays
rising with his mother, milking, feeding the animals
working the fields — ploughing, planting, weeding
visiting Tommy O'Brien, listening to his stories
visiting Colm at the forge, larking about
